echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Energy Regen, plus 22.5% ATK for the next Resonator on Outro. Bell-Borne Geochelone's shield and damage reduction pass to the team.

echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echo_sets.note: More defensive support for survival-focused builds. It boosts her healing-related utility.

build.energy_regen_target: not published; moderate — Energy Regen is 4th in her substat priorities (Liberation costs 140 energy)
build.fast_path: Fast path: Dauntless Evernight (or Discord, for faster rotations) + 5-piece Moonlit Clouds in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout, with Bell-Borne Geochelone in the main slot. Run CRIT Rate/DMG on the 4-cost and Havoc DMG on the 3-cost. Use DEF% on the 1-costs. Her shields and Liberation scale from DEF. Her Outro hands the next Resonator a Resonance Skill DMG amp.

ranked_weapons.name: Dauntless Evernight
ranked_weapons.note: Her best weapon. It has a DEF substat — her shields and Liberation scale from DEF. It also gives ATK and DEF on her Intro Skill.

ranked_weapons.name: Discord
ranked_weapons.note: Energy Regen, plus Concerto Energy on Resonance Skill. Her rotations run faster.

ranked_weapons.name: Autumntrace
ranked_weapons.note: ATK that stacks on Basic and Heavy hits. A decent stat stick for her on-field moments.

ranked_weapons.name: Broadblade#41
ranked_weapons.note: A craftable 4-star. Its ATK buff triggers on Resonance Skill.

ranked_weapons.name: Originite: Type I
ranked_weapons.note: A free 3-star with a DEF substat. It heals when she casts her Resonance Skill.

stat_priorities.note: Game8 lists CRIT; a DEF% 4-cost is viable for a pure tank build.
Havoc DMG for personal damage; Energy Regen is an option if Liberation uptime suffers.
DEF% on both 1-costs — feeds her shields and Liberation scaling.

profile.role_note: A defensive support who scales from DEF. She brings Rocksteady shields that cut damage, and timed Strategic Parries. Her Outro boosts the next Resonator's Resonance Skill DMG. Her Liberation hits hard from DEF on quick swaps.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: A defensive support. Her Outro boosts Resonance Skill DMG, which Jinhsi loves. She is genuinely useful in that one team. Everywhere else, she is too niche to pull for.

sources.record: Wuthering Waves Character Tier List for Version 3.7

members.name: Taoqi
members.note: Sub-DPS/support; quick-swaps in for timed parries, shields, and her Liberation, then Outros the Resonance Skill DMG buff.

members.name: Jinhsi
members.note: Main DPS; most of her damage comes from Resonance Skill, which Taoqi's Outro amplifies.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Team-wide buffs and sustain; also accelerates Jinhsi's Incandescence gain.

teams.name: Premium: Jinhsi + Taoqi + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Shorekeeper opens with her Liberation. Jinhsi builds Incandescence and bursts. Then Taoqi quick-swaps in for parries and her DEF-scaling Liberation. She Outros, handing Jinhsi a Resonance Skill DMG amp for her next burst.

members.name: Taoqi
members.note: Support; shields and Outro buff for Danjin's frequent Resonance Skill casts.

members.name: Danjin
members.note: Main DPS; appreciates Taoqi's Outro buff on her constant Resonance Skill usage.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Healing, team ATK buff, and DMG Deepen with off-field coordinated attacks.

teams.name: Alternative: Danjin + Taoqi + Verina
teams.rotation: Verina keeps the team alive and deepens its damage. Taoqi parries and shields on quick swaps. Then Danjin takes a long on-field window, with Taoqi's Resonance Skill DMG Outro boosting her frequent casts.

tier_badge.label: Situational
tier_badge.note: Rated C overall as a Sub-DPS on the current lists — C in both Tower of Adversity and Whimpering Wastes. A 3.7 list also places her at C. She has niche defensive value, but general supports have outgrown her.

+40% Power Shift shield — destructoid's first-priority node.
Rocksteady Shield duration to 30s — lootbar's top-rated node.
Free eventually; +40% Basic/Heavy Attack DMG while shielded.
